name: @arke-studio/desktop
description: Electron desktop shell: embeds the coordinator in main, supervises OpenCode and Voxa, and serves the React client as one app (SPEC-001 §2.2).

scripts.start: npm run build && npm run rebuild:native && electron dist/main.cjs
scripts.package: npm run prepare:runtimes && npm run verify:licenses -- --require-runtimes && npm run build && node scripts/package-windows.mjs --publish never
scripts.release: npm run prepare:runtimes && npm run verify:licenses -- --require-runtimes && npm run build && node scripts/package-windows.mjs --publish never
